notes: Tender perennial, grown as annual outside zone 9. Sweeter and milder than Greek oregano. Strong drying herb.
harvestIndicators: Tight knot-like buds about to open, strongest oil

careTasks.title: Sweet marjoram tends to be a low spreading plant that benefits from being pruned back when it is 6-8 inches tall to encourage a bushy growth habit.
Harvest marjoram when ball-like tips appear at the ends of the stems.
When the plant starts to bloom, cut plants back close to the ground to stimulate a new flush of growth.
